title: Surface Functionalization of Hepatitis E Virus Nanoparticles Using Chemical Conjugation Methods
protocol: Culture Sf9 cells in insect cell media to reach 50 - 75% confluence in 6-well plates.
Transfect Bacmids containing HEVNP-573C ORF2 into Sf9 cells using insect cell transfection reagents according to the manufacturer's protocols.
Incubate transfected cells at 27 °C for 3 - 6 days, depending on cell viability.
Collect supernatant at 3 - 6 days post-infection as P0 baculovirus stock.
Remove culture medium from Sf9 cells and apply 200 µL of P0 stock to 50 - 75% confluent Sf9 cells in a 25 cm2 monolayer flask.
Rock the flask every 15 min for full coverage of inoculum over 60 minutes, repeating four times.
Add 2 mL of insect cell culture medium to the flask and incubate at 27 °C for 3 - 6 days depending on viability of cells.
Carry out plaque assays to obtain baculovirus titer reading.
Culture suspended Tn5 insect cells with 100 mL of insect cell medium in a 250 mL flask.
Shake the flask in 27 °C at 150 rpm to achieve a titer of 0.5 x 10^5 - 1 x 10^6 for inoculation.
Add baculovirus at an MOI of 5 - 10 to 100 mL Tn5 cells in a 250 mL flask.
Shake the inoculated cells in a 27 °C incubator at 150 rpm for 5 - 7 days.
Collect Tn5 cells when most appear to have vesicles and 70-90% are dead under optical microscopy.
Transfer collected cells into ultracentrifuge tubes, balance them, and spin at 10,000 x g for 90 minutes at 25 °C.
Keep the supernatant containing HEVNPs at 4 °C for purification.
For long-term storage of baculovirus supernatant, add protease inhibitors.
Transfer collected supernatant to each tube and add 20% NP-40 to achieve a final concentration of 0.5% NP-40.
Gently mix by pipetting and incubate at 25 °C for at least 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the HEVNPs at 112,400 x g in swinging bucket rotors for 2 hours at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Re-suspend the crude pellet in 200 µL of 10 mM MES buffer pH 6.2 and incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Run SDS-PAGE to confirm the presence of HEVNP ORF2 as a 52 kDa band in the crude pellet.
Prepare a 38.5% (w/v) CsCl gradient by mixing 1.96 g CsCl, the re-suspended crude pellet, and ~4 mL of 0.01 M MES pH 6.2 in a 5 mL ultracentrifuge tube.
Balance the tubes and place them in a swinging bucket rotor.
Ultracentrifuge at 147,000 x g for 16 h at 4 °C.
Discard the top 500 µL fraction from the CsCl gradient.
Collect 500 µL fractions, starting from the top of the tube, and change tips in between each fraction.
Place each fraction into numbered/labeled 1.5 mL tubes.
Transfer each fraction to a 5 mL ultracentrifuge tube.
Dilute the CsCl with 4.5 mL of 10 mM MES, pH 6.2.
Balance the tubes and place them in a swinging bucket rotor.
Ultracentrifuge at 147,000 x g for 2 h at 4 °C to pellet down the HEVNPs.
Discard the supernatant.
Gently re-suspend the HEVNPs in 100 µL of 10 mM MES pH 6.2 in each tube.
Cover the tubes to avoid evaporation and incubate O/N at 4 °C.
Record the A280 reading and A260/A280 nm ratio using a spectrophotometer.
Prepare an SDS-PAGE.
Use a 6 μL sample from each fraction to determine the fractions containing 53.3 kDa HEVNP ORF2 protein.
Confirm the presence and purity of HEVNPs by TEM observation.
Prepare or dilute the HEVNP samples to 0.5 - 2.0 mg/mL for TEM.
Repeat step 2.1.3 through 2.2.6 if impurities are present under TEM.
Prepare SDS-PAGE 4-12% Bis-Tris Protein Gels, 1.0 mm, 17-wells according to the user's manual.
Add 2 μL of 4x loading buffer to 6 μL of protein sample.
Incubate the sample mixture in a heat block for 10 min at 100 °C.
Load the protein samples onto the gel.
Run the SDS-PAGE by setting the DC power supply at 100 V for 10 min, then 150 V for 45 min.
Stain the SDS-PAGE gel with Coomassie blue (0.25% (w/v) Coomassie Brilliant Blue R250, 30% (v/v) methanol, 10% (v/v) acetic acid) for 1 h.
Remove the Coomassie blue stain and apply de-staining buffer (30% (v/v) methanol, 10% (v/v) acetic acid) onto the protein gel for >12 h at room temperature.
Document the gel under white light to confirm the presence of HEVNP ORF2 at the 52 kDa band.
Observe the HEVNPs using TEM.
Prepare or dilute the HEVNP samples to 0.5 - 2 mg/mL with 10 mM MES pH 6.2 for TEM imaging.
Ionize the carbon-coated grids with 40 mA glow discharge for 30 s.
Hold in tweezers and add 2 μL of HEVNP sample to the grid, wait for 15 - 30 s, and blot with filter paper.
Immediately wash the grid with ddH2O and blot with filter paper.
Add 2 µL of 2% uranyl acetate to the grid.
Wait 15 seconds before blotting with filter paper.
Dry the sample grids in an electronic dehumidify dry cabinet overnight.
Transfer the grid into a TEM and image at magnifications between 10-80k.
Dialyze HEVNPs against 0.01 M PBS pH 7.4 using mini dialysis units for 1 hour.
Measure the protein concentration of HEVNPs at 280 nm using a spectrophotometer.
Mix HEVNP to achieve a concentration of 1 mg/mL, equivalent to 18.8 µM Cys reaction sites.
React with an equal amount of maleimide-biotin (100 µM) in PBS pH 7.4 at a 1:5 molar ratio overnight at 4 °C.
Remove unbound maleimide-biotin using a 40 K MWCO Spin Desalting column according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Analyze samples through standard reducing SDS-PAGE.
Prepare a chemiluminescent Western Blot using HRP-linked Streptavidin.
Capture the chemiluminescent signal with X ray film.
Apply HEVNPs in mini dialysis units and dialyze against 0.01 M PBS pH 7.4 at room temperature for 1 h.
Transfer the HEVNPs to 1.5 mL tubes.
Measure protein concentration at 280 nm using a spectrophotometer.
Add 650 µM maleimide-azide and 650 µM alkyne-LXY3010 in 0.01 M PBS pH 7.4 with 200 µM CuSO4 and 1 mM ascorbic acid to form maleimide-linked LXY30 (Mal-LXY30) at 650 µM.
Incubate the mixture at 4 °C for O/N.
Mix the HEVNP to 1 mg/mL, which is equivalent to 18.8 µM of Cys reaction site.
React with about 10% volume of Mal-LXY30 (650 µM) in 0.01 M PBS pH 7.4 at a 1:3 molar ratio O/N at 4 °C.
Remove unbound maleimide-click-LXY30 with a 40 K MWCO Spin Desalting column according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Mix the LXY30-linked HEVNPs (LXY30-HEVNPs) to 1 mg/mL, which is equivalent to 18.8 µM of the Cys reaction site.
React with equal volume of NHS-Cy5.5 (100 µM) in 0.01 M PBS pH 7.4 at a 1:5 molar ratio O/N at 4 °C.
Seed MDA-MB231 breast cancer cells into a 35-mm glass bottom dish (5 x 10^4 per dish) overnight in a mammalian cell culture cabinet.
Dilute LXY30-HEVNP-Cy5.5 to 0.01 mg/mL, equivalent to 0.188 μM of HEVNP ORF2, in 250 µL of 0 - 1% FBS/DMEM for the cell binding experiment.
Prepare a negative control sample at 0.01 mg/mL HEVNP-Cy5.5 by conjugating with NHS-Cy5.5 dye only and diluting to 0.01 mg/mL in 250 µL of 10% FBS supplemented with DMEM.
Wash the cells once with 250 µL of 1 M PBS buffer, pH 7.4.
Apply 250 µL of LXY30-HEVNP-Cy5.5 or HEVNP-Cy5.5 in 10% FBS supplemented with DMEM to the cultured cells.
Shield the cell culture dishes from light with aluminum foil.
Keep the cell culture dishes in a 37 °C cell culture cabinet for 1 h for internalization.
Wash the cultured cells on ice three times, 5 min per wash, with 250 µL of 1 M PBS, pH 7.4.
Fix the cells in 4% PFA in 1 M PBS, pH 7.4 for 20 min.
Wash the fixed cells once with 250 µL of 1 M PBS, pH 7.4.
